general_notes: Candidates fall into five recurring types per state: (1) the exact target inset in a flat border frame; (2) the target shown in-app on a square dark canvas with a round vignette (three to four near-identical copies per state, which I scored identically unless I could see a difference); (3) the in-app view zoomed/cropped so legs and outer flames are cut off; (4) a heavily blurred copy at target framing; (5) a different smooth 3D/vector re-render. Small differences between the in-app copies (ember density in joyful G, smoke volume in depleted E) are at the edge of what I can see at this resolution and may be uncertain. The depleted target itself contains a grey rectangle at lower right that looks like an artefact; I did not penalise its absence in vignette versions on the character dimensions. Motion judgments come from six still frames per loop, so smoothness between frames and timing could not be assessed directly; all eight sequences show low-amplitude motion, with joyful Y the most expressive.
